title: Latency Variance Explorer: per-model & per-route p50/p95/p99 with streaming vs non-streaming decomposition
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build an interactive ‘Latency Variance Explorer’ dashboard that lets SREs and platform engineers analyze p50/p95/p99 latency by model and route, and decompose those percentiles into streaming vs non-streaming contributions. The explorer will surface percentile deltas over configurable windows, highlight routes with high variance, and provide one-click drilldowns to correlated traces and logs. This will bridge gaps between tracing hooks and pre-aggregated metrics to reduce time-to-detect and time-to-debug regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard exposes p50/p95/p99 for each model+route pair with a streaming/non-streaming stacked breakdown
Percentile delta strip (configurable baseline window) highlights routes with >20% increase in p95
Clicking a route+model drills down to a trace sample set filtered by the same streaming flag and shows top 5 span-level contributors
Queries run within 2s for datasets up to 3M requests/day using pre-aggregations
Telemetry changes are backwards compatible; existing alerts continue to work
Documentation and runbook updated with new dashboard links and triage steps
implementation_notes: Add trace hook to attach 'redwood.route' and 'redwood.model' tags to spans at request ingress (PR drafted)
Emit a request-level metric 'request.duration_ms' with label 'streaming=true|false' at response completion for efficient aggregation
Pipeline: route request.duration_ms into Prometheus histogram buckets and into ClickHouse for percentile rolls; use pre-aggregated hourly histograms for dashboard backfill
Use Tempo sampling: sample 1% globally + adaptive sampling (100% for routes with p95 delta > 15% in last 1h) to surface traces for problematic routes
UI pattern: small multiples by model with per-route panels; add violin plots for variance and a delta sparkline for p95 vs baseline
Consider cardinality: cap model+route pairs to top-500 by qps and expose full set via search with on-demand query
Runbook: if p95 delta triggered, inspect trending metric, open trace set, check kernel scheduling and kv cache hit rates
Cost control: store raw spans for 14 days; aggregated histograms for 90 days; document retention trade-offs
